I dey farm cassava and yam for this rented land, na im be my main work this season. Since na rented land, I no wan spend too much money on fertilizer because the landlord fit change mind next year. I go buy small NPK when I get money, maybe half bag, and use the manure from my neighbor goats wey dey near my house. For the planting material, I go use the cassava stems wey I save from last year and small yam seed wey I get from my uncle — no money for improved varieties. Weeds na big problem for this humid place, so I go buy small herbicide, and I go work the land myself with my wife, only hire people for clearing and harvest time.
